observations.observation: Page title and tagline: the original's title is the brand plus an all-caps tagline ('KNEEguru | YOUR SOURCE OF KNEE INFORMATION'), and the same tagline appears under the logo. The AI-built page's title is 'Knee Guru – the place to go for information about knees'.

tags.value: changed: brand with caps tagline title becomes plain sentence title

observations.observation: Heading hierarchy: the original has no h1. Its outline starts at h2 'Knee Guru', then h3 'Content Group'/'Bullet Points', and it uses 16 h4s loosely. The AI-built page has one h1 ('Your place to go for information about knees') followed by an orderly h2 → h3 → h4 outline.

tags.value: changed: flat empty outline becomes structured h1 h2 h3 h4

observations.observation: Semantic landmarks: the original uses only header, nav and footer, with 217 divs and no main or section. The AI-built page uses header, nav, main, 6 sections and footer, with 28 divs. Neither page uses article, aside or figure.

tags.value: changed: divs and header nav footer become header nav main sections footer
changed: heavy div markup becomes minimal markup

observations.observation: Content column: both pages use a centred fixed-width column on a 1440px canvas. The original's column is about 1140px (x=150–1290); the AI-built page's is about 1068px (x=186–1254), and every section aligns to it.

tags.value: changed: 1200px column becomes narrower 1068px column in full-bleed bands

observations.observation: Layout technique: the original uses no flex or grid (0/0) and relies on float or table-style Bootstrap-era layout. The AI-built page uses flexbox on 29 elements and CSS grid on 5.

tags.value: changed: floats and fixed widths become flex plus grid

observations.observation: A light-grey strip about 130px tall at the very top holds a centred 'Banner - Hide this banner' line with an external-link icon.

tags.value: dropped: grey top banner with hide link

observations.observation: Logo: the original uses a large two-tone image logo (teal 'KNEE' with an olive 'guru' script) and the tagline beneath it. The AI-built page uses a text wordmark in a heavy, tightly tracked sans-serif, with 'KNEE' in dark navy and 'guru' in blue.

tags.value: changed: two-tone script image logo becomes bold sans text wordmark

observations.observation: A header search box at the right: a square input with a blue icon button (rgb(0,136,204)).

tags.value: dropped: header search box with blue icon button

observations.observation: Social links: the original shows four circular icon buttons (Twitter, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest) in the header under the search box. The AI-built page shows plain inline text links ('Follow us') in the footer, with no icons.

tags.value: changed: header icon buttons become footer text links

observations.observation: Header and nav arrangement: the original puts the logo at the left and a right-aligned row of small bold uppercase blue nav links. The AI-built page uses a two-row header: wordmark and buttons on top, then a horizontal nav row of bold dark-navy links in mixed case, separated from the content by a thin bottom border.

tags.value: changed: right-aligned uppercase links become two-row header with mixed-case nav

observations.observation: Both pages have the same nav items, and Learning Portfolio, Community and Product Reviews carry dropdown carets. The AI-built page implements these as native details/summary elements with 230px link panels (7, 8 and 3 links), closed by default.

tags.value: kept: same nav items with dropdown carets as details summary

observations.observation: Text-size controls: the original has three blue-outlined 'A' icons of increasing size at the bottom right of the footer. The AI-built page has three tiny GIF buttons (-A, A, +A) in bordered, rounded buttons at the top right of the header.

tags.value: changed: footer a icons become header gif buttons

observations.observation: Hero layout: the original shows a 570×570 photo on the left with an olive-grey translucent overlay panel (rgb(62,62,47)) across its lower part, extending past the photo to the right. The AI-built page uses a two-column split: text on the left, and a 460×460 photo with rounded corners on the right. Both use the same photo of a man drawing a knee on a whiteboard.

tags.value: changed: photo with translucent overlay panel becomes two-column text and rounded photo

observations.observation: Hero photo alt text: the original's hero image has an empty alt. The AI-built page's hero alt is descriptive ('A man in a blue striped shirt drawing a knee joint on a whiteboard…').

tags.value: changed: empty hero alt becomes descriptive alt

observations.observation: Hero headline and call to action: the original's overlay has a light-weight white h2 'Learn about knees…' and no CTA button. The AI-built page has a bold 51.2px navy h1, a larger slate lead paragraph, and one dark-blue rounded button ('Look up a knee topic').

tags.value: changed: light white h2 becomes bold navy h1 with lead and button
changed: dark blue rounded hero button

observations.observation: Six task actions (look up a topic, anatomy, forum, rehab exercises, locate a surgeon, book a consultation) appear on both pages with a dotted-arrow bullet image. In the original they are white text in a two-column list inside the hero overlay. In the AI-built page they are a separate 'Ways to learn about knees' 3×2 grid of bordered, rounded white tiles (348×56) with centred bold labels.

tags.value: changed: white text list in hero overlay becomes bordered tile grid

observations.observation: Category tiles (Primers, Courses, eBooks, Expert Views, General Articles, Journal Interpretations) form a 3×2 grid on both pages. The original places large (~100–120px) icons above white label cards on a pale grey (#EBEBEB) panel, with the description below on the grey. The AI-built page uses whole-card links in white, rounded, hairline-bordered cards (345×148), with a 52px icon at the left, a blue h3 title and a grey description.

tags.value: changed: large icons above label cards become whole-card bordered cards with side icon

observations.observation: Both pages use multi-colour flat SVG pictograms (grey, orange, blue, navy and others) for the category icons, loaded as img files rather than inline SVG (svgs 0 on both).

tags.value: kept: flat svg pictograms loaded as img files

observations.observation: Category icon alt text: in the original, all six icons share the alt 'Primers', which does not match their content. In the AI-built page they are treated as decorative, with empty alt.

tags.value: changed: repeated mismatched alts become empty decorative alts

observations.observation: The category icons overlap the top edge of their label cards and the hero image's bounding box (image_overlaps 5488px² and 3360px²).

tags.value: dropped: icons overlapping card and hero edges

observations.observation: Card descriptions wrap to 2–3 lines inside cards of fixed height, which leaves empty space at the bottom of the shorter cards.

tags.value: added: fixed height cards with empty space

observations.observation: Typeface: the original uses Open Sans (410 elements) with FontAwesome for icons. The AI-built page uses only a system-ui stack (system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto) on 264 elements and has no icon font.

tags.value: changed: open sans becomes system-ui stack
changed: icon fonts for social and ui glyphs

observations.observation: A handwritten script face, Shadows Into Light, is used sparingly (2 elements), for the 'More about us…' tab.

tags.value: dropped: handwritten script face on more about tab

observations.observation: 'More about us…' link: the original shows it as a blue tab with a folded-corner triangle on the footer edge. The AI-built page shows it as a plain underlined link in the sponsors band.

tags.value: changed: folded-corner blue tab becomes plain underlined link

observations.observation: h2 style: the original's h2s are large and thin (35.2px, weight 300) in near-black rgb(29,33,39). The AI-built page's h2s are smaller and bold (27.2px, weight 700) in navy.

tags.value: changed: large thin h2 becomes smaller bold navy h2

observations.observation: Each h2 is followed by a short, muted subtitle paragraph (for example 'Pick the route that suits you.').

tags.value: added: muted subtitle paragraph under each h2

observations.observation: Body text: both pages set it at 16px. The original uses mid-grey rgb(119,119,119) at a 24px line height. The AI-built page uses dark navy rgb(29,43,58) at a 25.6px line height, with slate rgb(82,101,122) for secondary text.

tags.value: changed: mid-grey body text becomes near-black with grey meta

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 16px 1.5 becomes 16px 1.6

observations.observation: Both pages present Latest Content as a vertical list of ten entries. Each entry has a blue title link and a one-line grey summary, the entries are separated by thin rules, and each row is about 88px. Neither has thumbnails.

tags.value: kept: vertical list of ruled entries with title and summary

observations.observation: Latest Content container: the original's list sits directly on the white page. The AI-built page wraps the list in a single bordered, rounded white panel (1068×883).

tags.value: changed: list on page becomes bordered rounded panel

observations.observation: List title markup: the original's list titles are h4 links. The AI-built page's are links nested inside h3s, and the link box is smaller than the heading box.

tags.value: changed: h4 links become links nested in h3

observations.observation: Years ('2020', '2017') appear as small grey inline spans beside the list titles, or at the front of one title. The original's list shows no dates.

tags.value: added: small grey year spans beside titles

observations.observation: Inline glossary links in summaries (meniscus, MRI, knee surgeon, knee replacement, rheumatoid arthritis, arthrofibrosis): the original styles them green with a dotted underline, which sets them apart from the blue titles. The AI-built page styles them blue with a solid underline, while titles are bold blue with no underline.

tags.value: changed: green dotted glossary links become blue solid underlined

observations.observation: Palette: the original has a white body with grey text, a bright blue accent rgb(0,136,204), an olive-brown hero overlay and a near-black footer. The AI-built page has a pale blue-grey body rgb(246,249,252), white cards, a deeper blue accent rgb(11,92,138), navy and slate text, and a light-blue sponsors band rgb(232,242,249).

tags.value: changed: white grey and bright blue becomes pale blue-grey with deep blue and navy

observations.observation: Corner radius: the original is almost entirely square (417 elements at 0, 15 at 1–7px, 8 pills, primary button 0px). The AI-built page rounds cards, buttons, inputs and the hero image (29 at 1–7px, 24 at 8–15px, 0 pills, primary button 6px).

tags.value: changed: square corners become small rounding

observations.observation: Effects: both pages use minimal decoration with no backdrop blur or animations. The original has 9 box-shadows, 1 gradient, 26 transitions and 16 transforms. The AI-built page has 3 box-shadows and no gradients, transitions or transforms, and relies on hairline borders.

tags.value: changed: shadows and transitions become thin borders

observations.observation: Sponsors section: the original has a short paragraph and two small logos (Joint Operations, and Össur with a thin black frame) centred on white. The AI-built page uses a full-bleed light-blue band with a left-aligned h2, a funding paragraph and three white rounded tiles: the same two logos plus a text-only 'The Regenerative Clinic' tile.

tags.value: changed: centered logos on white become tinted band with logo tiles

observations.observation: A thick rounded grey bar (about 8px) spans the column above the footer as a divider.

tags.value: dropped: thick grey bar above footer

observations.observation: Footer: the original's footer is a near-black full-bleed band (rgb(14,14,14)) with white text, light-weight h2s and four uneven columns (Professional Standards, Corporate Details, Stay in touch, Your safety). The AI-built page's footer is a white band with a top rule, three equal 340px columns with small h4s (address/registration, Policies, Follow us), grey text and underlined blue links.

tags.value: changed: near-black four-column footer becomes white three-column footer

observations.observation: Professional standards and newsletter signup appear in a two-up row of equal bordered white cards (524×258) above the footer, rather than as footer columns.
